result.scope_note: SPHEREx and PUNCH were indeed launched together on a Falcon 9 rocket from Space Launch Complex 4E at Vandenberg Space Force Base, not Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The claim incorrectly states the launch site as Kennedy Space Center in California. Vandenberg Space Force Base is the correct coastal California launch site for these missions.
